title: Vietnamese-Style Grilled Chicken Skewers
description: Delicious and easy-to-make skewers of marinated chicken, perfect for a summer evening. Inspired by the flavors of Vietnam, these skewers are a must-try for any grill master.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
2. Add the chicken drumsticks to the marinade and toss to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Brush the coconut oil onto the skewers and season with salt and pepper.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
8. Garnish with green onions and lemongrass.
